title: BiomassSupplyPack (v1.0-current)
description: Structural validation schema for the BiomassSupplyPack artefact family, v1.0-current layer only. Normative basis: docs/87 (design), docs/88 (implementation authorisation), docs/89 (signed-off Layer-1 vocabulary), docs/90 (implementation encodings). This schema checks required-field presence, types, closed-vocabulary membership, and numeric bounds. It does NOT validate source authority or credibility of EECA, PF Olsen, Ahika, or Beca; it does NOT certify exact transcription or extraction fidelity from primary reports that are not held; it does NOT re-derive or certify the physical truth of the external regional resource estimate; and it does NOT treat Layer-1 membership as a validation-gate outcome. Evidential checks that a separate validator may perform are limited to derived arithmetic of this artefact's own declared inputs and to source-identity/registration lookup. Layer-2 properties declare limitations; they do not establish seasonal capability, dynamic competing-demand modelling, contractual access, GIS/route feasibility, site feasibility, or dispatch feasibility. additionalProperties is false.

artefact_id.description: Per-instance identity, distinct from semantic_version and schema_version (docs/88 section 5). UUID5 assembled from family, semantic version, formalised-summary SHA-256, assumptions-TOML SHA-256, and upstream dispatch-bundle identity (docs/90 section 4). Unit: none (identifier). Not a validation outcome.

semantic_version.description: Family semantic version. Incremented only on material semantic change to evidence, relevant assumptions, derivation logic, or governed interpretation (docs/87 section 9; docs/88 section 5). A routine upstream rerun produces a new artefact_id under the same semantic_version. Unit: none (version label).

schema_version.description: Contract-layer identity for this schema file, following the IncrementalElectricityPack v1.0-current convention (docs/88 section 8). Distinct from artefact_id. Unit: none (contract label).

artefact_family.description: Fixed family label for this distinct candidate artefact family (docs/87 section 10). Presence of this label does not by itself establish a fully demonstrated second governed family or Paper 1 inclusion (docs/88 section 1, section 18).

supported_decision_claim_class.description: Layer 1 result-scope/status: the class of decision claim this instance supports (docs/89 signed-off field). Closed one-member vocabulary. REGIONAL_SCREENING_BOUNDED means a bounded regional-screening claim only. This is not a validation outcome, not an evidence-status grade, not IncrementalElectricityPack qualification_codes, and not a certification of the underlying external biomass estimates. Site-level feasibility, dispatch feasibility, seasonal capability, contractual access, and procurement readiness are not supported claim classes.

geographic_boundary.description: Layer 2 declared limitation: the pool is Southland-regional, not site-specific (docs/88 section 3.2). Does not establish site-level accessibility. Copied from the formalised bundle. Unit: none (boundary label).

temporal_resolution.description: Layer 2 declared limitation: the quantities are an annual aggregate, not a seasonal or monthly profile (docs/87 section 2, section 7; docs/90 section 5). Does not supply or model seasonal availability. Unit: none (resolution label).

resource_quantity_character.description: Layer 2 declared limitation: the regional pool is a static, externally sourced, multi-year average and is not computed or re-derived by this project (docs/87 section 6). Copied from the formalised bundle field regional_resource_quantity_character. Does not certify physical truth of that external estimate.

competing_demand_treatment.description: Layer 2 declared limitation: competing demand is only partially and statically netted (docs/87 section 7; docs/90 section 5). Does not perform dynamic competing-demand modelling and cannot represent a dynamic-netting claim.

accessibility_radius.description: Layer 2 declared limitation: eligibility/scoping radius. Unit: km. First authorised instance uses 100. This is not a cost-calculation input and is not a demonstration of delivery feasibility. Must remain distinct from transport_cost_distance_basis (docs/88 section 3.2).

accessibility_basis.description: Layer 2 declared limitation: accessibility_radius is an eligibility/scoping framing, not a cost-calculation parameter (docs/87 section 7).

transport_cost_distance_basis.description: Layer 2 declared limitation: illustrative transport-distance assumption embedded in the published delivered-cost tiers. Unit: km. First authorised instance uses 60. Kept as a separate property from accessibility_radius; the 60 km / 100 km relationship remains unresolved (docs/84 section 3; docs/87 section 2). Does not establish a transport model.

contractual_access_status.description: Layer 2 declared limitation: contractual or licensed access has not been established (docs/87 section 7). Does not hold contractual or licensing records.

regional_pool_total_tonnes_per_year.description: Annual regional accessible resource, mass basis. Copied from the formalised bundle / EV-0050 transcription already held there. Unit: tonnes/year. Copied, not re-derived. Presence does not validate the external estimate.

regional_pool_total_tj_per_year.description: Annual regional accessible resource, energy basis. Copied from the formalised bundle. Unit: TJ/year. Copied, not re-derived.

conditional_tonnes_per_year.description: BB1 annual biomass requirement, mass basis, already derived in the formalised screen from the canonical BB1 dispatch summary. Unit: tonnes/year. Copied from the formalised bundle; not recomputed by the BiomassSupplyPack producer.

canonical_bb1_annual_fuel_MWh.description: BB1 annual fuel requirement. Unit: MWh_fuel/year. Copied from the formalised bundle.

canonical_bb1_annual_fuel_GJ.description: BB1 annual fuel requirement. Unit: GJ/year. Copied from the formalised bundle.

bb1_share_of_regional_pool_mass_basis_pc.description: BB1 share of the regional pool, mass basis. Unit: percent. Derived in the formalised bundle as 100 * conditional_tonnes_per_year / regional_pool_total_tonnes_per_year. Independently re-derived by the BiomassSupplyPack validator. Not a site-feasibility determination.

bb1_share_of_regional_pool_energy_basis_.description: BB1 share of the regional pool, energy basis. Unit: percent. Derived in the formalised bundle from canonical_bb1_annual_fuel_GJ and regional_pool_total_tj_per_year. Independently re-derived by the validator.

physical_limit_binding_indicator.description: Copied from the formalised bundle. True only if the regional screening representation indicates the pool is exhausted relative to the declared requirement. False does not establish site-level feasibility. Contextual validator check: must be false when mass-basis share is less than 100.

evidence_ids.description: Record-level source-identity bag copied from the formalised bundle. Registers identity of cited evidence IDs only. Does not assert source authority, quantity-level mapping, or physical truth (docs/87 section 4, section 6).

evidence_source_vintage.description: Record-level evidence/source vintage copied from the formalised source_vintage_note. Staleness signal only. Not an independent vintage validation.

canonical_upstream_dispatch_bundle.description: Upstream run-family identity copied from the formalised bundle. Unit: none (identifier).

canonical_bb1_summary_input_path.description: Path identity of the canonical BB1 dispatch summary used by the formalised screen. Copied. Known absolute-path portability limitation (docs/87 section 8). Unit: none (path).

assumptions_toml_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex, lowercase) of biomass_supply_screen_assumptions.toml as recorded in the formalised bundle. Recomputed by the validator from the live file (read-only). Unit: none (checksum).

assumptions_toml_path.description: Path identity of the assumptions file whose checksum is recorded. Copied from the formalised bundle. Unit: none (path).

producer_script_identity.description: Computational provenance of this governed instance (docs/88 section 6). Distinct from the formalised screen script, which remains unmodified.

source_formalised_bundle.description: Read-only source bundle identity for this producer (docs/88 section 11). Not a write target.

source_ids.description: Optional. Record-level source-register identifiers copied from the formalised bundle. Source identity/registration only. Not a source-authority assessment (docs/87 section 6).

tier_allocation.description: Optional. Per-tier allocation copied from the existing formalised allocation CSV. Not required for regional screening. Not a transport, GIS, or supply-chain model.

weighted_delivered_cost_nzd_per_gj_low.description: Optional. Weighted delivered cost, low. Unit: NZD/GJ. If any delivered-cost property is present, price_basis_status must also be present. Does not establish procurement or funding readiness.

weighted_delivered_cost_nzd_per_gj_mid.description: Optional. Weighted delivered cost, mid. Unit: NZD/GJ.

weighted_delivered_cost_nzd_per_gj_high.description: Optional. Weighted delivered cost, high. Unit: NZD/GJ.

price_basis_status.description: Optional. Qualifier required alongside any delivered-cost property (docs/87 section 2). Existing formalised token. Does not validate underlying cost-survey estimates.

merit_order_intact_at_marginal_high.description: Optional. Merit-order indicator from the formalised bundle. Relevant only to bounded relative cost comparison, not to regional screening.

limitations_caveats.description: Optional. Free-text supplement. Cannot substitute for Layer 1 or Layer 2 (docs/87 section 2). A qualification-consumer test must not read this field.
